scholarships.funding_note: Excellence scholarship of the French Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs for master's and PhD study in France; only applications submitted by French higher education institutions are accepted — students cannot apply directly.
scholarships.provider: French Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs (via Campus France)
scholarships.title: France Excellence Eiffel Scholarship

scholarships.cycle_note: Open now — consortia generally accept applications between October and January each year for courses starting the following academic year; each joint master sets its own deadline in the Erasmus Mundus Catalogue, so there is no single closing date.
scholarships.eligibility_note: Requires a bachelor's degree (students in the final year of a bachelor's may also apply); students apply directly to the individual Erasmus Mundus joint master consortium listed in the official catalogue — there is no HEC or Pakistan-quota route.
scholarships.funding_note: Erasmus Mundus scholarships cover participation costs plus travel, visa and a living allowance for the full joint master's programme, which is studied in at least two European countries.
scholarships.title: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters (European Union)

scholarships.cycle_note: 2027 call: Spring/Summer 2027 intake deadline 30 Oct 2026 has passed; Fall 2027 intake deadline is 30 Mar 2027 and is still open. HEC's programme page still shows 'Scholarships are Open'.
scholarships.eligibility_note: Pakistani/AJ&K nationals; 4-year bachelor's degree (16 years of education); maximum one second division in the academic career; maximum age 40 years for regular government employees / public-sector faculty / approved R&D researchers, 35 years in all other cases (on the closing date); must not be availing any other scholarship. PhD only (no Master's/MS-leading-to-PhD). Secured admission in a top-100 QS-ranked US university plus valid GRE General score of at least 300 in total OR HEC HAT score of at least 60%.
scholarships.funding_note: Category I (top 50 QS-ranked US universities): tuition fee as per university invoice, stipend USD 19,000 per year, health insurance USD 2,000 per year. Category II (51–100 QS): tuition up to USD 12,000 per year, stipend USD 19,000 per year, health insurance USD 2,000 per year. (Per HEC's 2027 advertisement.)
scholarships.title: HEC US–Pakistan Knowledge Corridor PhD Scholarship 2027

scholarships.cycle_note: 2026–27 call; apply only through the KPEF online scholarship portal before 31 December 2026; interviews at university campuses for final recommendations.
scholarships.eligibility_note: At least 70% marks in the last attended examination or 3.00 CGPA (Arts Specialized University: Merit Aptitude Test); KP domicile; admission in an approved institution in Pakistan; enrolled in the first year of a BS or MS programme (Emerging Sciences, Engineering Sciences, Management Sciences, General Sciences, Allied Health Sciences and Arts Groups); parents'/guardian's monthly income not exceeding Rs 160,000; not availing any other scholarship.
scholarships.funding_note: Merit-cum-inaffordability scholarship for first-year BS & MS students; renewal requires 3.00 CGPA. (The KPEF programme page states no award amount.)
scholarships.gender_scope: All (awarded equally among male and female students)
scholarships.provider: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Education Foundation (KPEF), Government of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
scholarships.title: KPEF Merit-cum-Inaffordability Scholarship Scheme 2026–27
